research_question: Do cross-sectionally idiosyncratic four-hour overreactions reverse after an independently completed fifteen-minute reclaim strongly enough to trade back toward the originating auction midpoint after twenty basis points of costs?

external_mechanism.source: De Nicola (2021), On the Intraday Behavior of Bitcoin
reused: negative first-order autocorrelation at one-, two- and four-hour frequencies
larger price movements exhibit stronger subsequent percentage reversals
overreaction, excess volatility and leverage cascades as candidate mechanisms
adapted: cross-sectional residual state across BTC, ETH, SOL and XRP
direction is not flipped until a separate completed reclaim bar
target is the midpoint of the originating four-hour auction
one global position across four assets

scenario.context: a completed four-hour return with absolute prior-only z-score at least two and displacement at least one and a half four-hour ATRs
scenario.liquidity_objective: the midpoint of the completed four-hour event auction
scenario.state: the focal market is the unique largest cross-sectional residual overreaction, at least one ATR from the median and at least a quarter ATR ahead of the second residual
scenario.interaction: the completed event has above-prior-median quote volume
scenario.confirmation: the next completed fifteen-minute bar moves opposite the event, reclaims at least ten percent of the event body, closes directionally within its range and has opposite taker pressure
scenario.entry: confirmation close in the reclaim direction
scenario.invalidation: beyond the event extreme plus ten percent of prior four-hour ATR
scenario.management: target or stop first; otherwise exit after eight hours
scenario.arbitration: one global open position; choose larger residual-overreaction quality

data.source: Binance Vision USD-M monthly and latest daily five-minute klines
data.visibility: event state uses completed four-hour bars and prior-only rolling statistics; entry follows a separately completed fifteen-minute reclaim

advance_gate.final_integrated_system_frequency_requir: at least one independent completed trade per calendar day

decision_contract.advance: Only the unchanged reclaim scenario passing every declared split advances to NautilusTrader.
decision_contract.reject: Do not tune overreaction, residual, reclaim, stop or target thresholds after evaluation.
